objective: Proof and computation. The claiming lemma: in a point split, a port is the odd point of its line exactly when that line takes the single skip of the face opposite the split point, so the claim is felt by every line of that face. Test on ladders, thick tubes (subdivided bipyramid duals), grids, random grown spaces and a ladder arm spliced onto a grid, with the Fano plane (and census 58) as handle, whether the halo beyond distance 3 consists exactly of lines on the three faces opposite the attachment point; compare with the frozen and liquid parts.
status: Proved by PHASE-HALO-20261103-001A-P001: a port is odd on its line exactly when that line takes the single skip of the face opposite the port (claiming lemma), and with the Fano plane as handle every halo line beyond distance 3 lies on a face opposite the attachment point at all 126 points tested (ladders, thick tubes, a grid, random grown spaces, a ladder arm on a grid; exactly those faces' far lines at 124). The reach follows face size rather than dimer phase; census 58 as handle also uses the point's own long face (5 of 24 points)
title: Opposite faces carry the halo
